verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS compliance platform, but nothing in the pack shows Drata's core platform can be self-hosted. The open-source Drata Agent that users build locally (drata-gh-5) is only an endpoint posture-monitoring client and does not count as the core product. The 'connect on-premise tools' integrations (drata-docs-55) are an adjacent feature, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
